bridges.title: Induction and indexed arguments
bridges.lesson: To prove P(n) for every integer n≥n0, prove the base case and prove P(k) implies P(k+1) for an arbitrary k≥n0. State the range and carry the whole hypothesis. Testing finitely many cases is not induction.

bridges.title: Integers, divisibility and parity
bridges.lesson: An integer is even if it equals2k for an integer k; divisibility a|b means b=ak for an integer k. Congruence modulo m compares integer remainders. Never infer these properties just from a decimal approximation.

bridges.title: Partial derivatives and planar integration
bridges.lesson: A partial derivative varies one coordinate while holding others fixed. Integrate a planar density over its actual region; describe the inner variable bounds in terms of the outer variable. A2×2 Jacobian determinant is ad−bc. These tools are supplied before tasks that require them, not leaked inside WALL.

campaign.title: The charter of Aster
campaign.place: Aster, a city built across the decks of a vast skyship
campaign.incident: The old charter has been challenged. Two guilds claim the right to name the expedition that will leave the city at dawn. The council has agreed to accept an independent mathematical record before choosing its next public action.
campaign.role: You hold the expedition seal. Your completed record will enter the charter hearing and earn your delegation the right to speak.
campaign.cast: Nara arrives with a travel-worn banner. “An expedition should belong to the people brave enough to join it.” Kei places an unsigned charter beside it. “Then let them hear what they are being promised.” The chamber doors open for your submission.
choice: Hold the public hearing on the open deck
Hold it in the lantern-lit archive
campaign.closure: The accepted records enter the charter hearing. Aster authorizes the expedition, and the departure bell sounds.
choiceOutcomes: The hearing moves to the open deck. Islanders gather along the rail as Nara raises the expedition banner.
Kei lights the archive lamps. The delegates take their places around the charter table.

campaign.title: The fleet of unanswered letters
campaign.place: the harbor district beneath Aster’s engine towers
campaign.incident: A courier fleet has returned carrying petitions from islands that have not spoken to one another in years. The captains disagree over how the expedition should represent their requests. A public contest of independently justified investigations will establish the record used by the hearing.
campaign.role: You are the expedition’s investigator. A certified submission earns the right to put the islands’ next petition before the assembly.
campaign.cast: Sora lays a bundle of weathered letters on the captain’s table. “The smallest islands sent these first.” Ren unrolls the assembly register. “Then someone must stand beside their promises.” Across the harbor, the waiting fleet lights its lamps.
choice: Invite Sora to introduce the petitions
Invite Ren to introduce the petitions
campaign.closure: The petitions are entered into the public record. The fleet raises its banners and joins the expedition.
choiceOutcomes: Sora steps forward and reads the smallest island’s petition first.
Ren introduces the petitions and names a witness for each promise.

campaign.title: The observatory above the storm
campaign.place: an abandoned observatory tethered above the cloud line
campaign.incident: A rival delegation has reached the observatory first and claimed its sealed archive. Its curator offers both delegations the same terms: present complete mathematical investigations before the archive hearing. The rivalry concerns who earns access, not whose unsupported answers sound more confident.
campaign.role: You speak for Aster at the archive hearing. Your completed record earns an audience with the curator and access to the expedition’s next destination.
campaign.cast: Kei stops before the sealed archive doors. “If we earn the hearing, I want everyone to read what is inside.” Nara studies the curator’s empty chair. “First I want to know why it was closed.” Footsteps announce the rival delegation.
choice: Ask for a public reading after the hearing
Ask for a private conversation with the curator
campaign.closure: The hearing accepts the expedition’s record. The curator opens the archive, and the next destination is revealed through the story.
choiceOutcomes: The curator announces a public reading. Kei carries the first volume into the waiting hall.
Nara joins you in the curator’s quiet study for the story behind the archive.

campaign.title: The night market’s oath
campaign.place: a floating night market under thousands of paper lanterns
campaign.incident: The market’s hosts have promised the expedition an audience with an elusive mapmaker. A rival patron challenges that promise. The hosts require an independently established mathematical record before ruling on the dispute; no merchant sells clues or better odds of academic success.
campaign.role: You prepare the record on which the market’s hosts will decide whether to honor the promised audience.
campaign.cast: Ren places the hosts’ invitation beneath a lantern. “An oath does not expire when a richer patron arrives.” Sora lifts the island petitions. “And the mapmaker should hear more than the patrons.” The market falls quiet as the hosts take their seats.
choice: Bring the petitions to the audience
Bring the expedition’s charter to the audience
campaign.closure: The hosts honor the oath. The mapmaker receives the expedition, and your chosen document sets the subject of the conversation.
choiceOutcomes: Sora unfolds the island petitions before the mapmaker, who asks where their writers call home.
Ren lays out the charter. The mapmaker asks which promise will guide the expedition next.

campaign.title: Signals from the far shore
campaign.place: a relay station overlooking an unmapped sea
campaign.incident: An invitation arrives from the far shore. The station’s custodians will convene a diplomatic meeting once the expedition’s mathematical record has passed independent review. The invitation remains open while you work; no countdown changes the task.
campaign.role: You establish the record required for the meeting. The invitation remains open while you work.
campaign.cast: Nara reads the invitation aloud. “Someone beyond the charts is expecting us.” Kei opens the expedition diary. “Then this belongs in the account of our voyage.” Beyond the windows, dawn reaches the far shore.
choice: Announce the meeting to the whole crew
Record the invitation in the diary first
campaign.closure: The custodians recognize the completed record and arrange the meeting. The expedition sails toward the far shore.
choiceOutcomes: Nara announces the meeting on deck. The crew gathers to hear the invitation together.
Kei enters the invitation in the diary, then hands you the pen to sign the account.

campaign.title: The council of rival banners
campaign.place: a council hall carved into a coastal cliff
campaign.incident: Three delegations dispute who may carry the next expedition charter. The council has separated political testimony from mathematical certification. Your completed investigations determine whether Aster’s submission qualifies for the final hearing; they do not force anyone to agree with its politics.
campaign.role: You are Aster’s independent verifier. Your completed investigations bring its submission to the final hearing.
campaign.cast: Sora stands beneath the island banners. “Let the charter belong to all of them.” Ren rests a hand on the empty captain’s chair. “And when a promise is broken, who answers?” The council calls Aster’s delegation forward.
choice: Advocate a shared charter in the story hearing
Advocate a named expedition leader in the story hearing
campaign.closure: Aster’s submission is admitted. The council hears your chosen position and signs a charter for the next voyage.
choiceOutcomes: Sora carries the shared charter beneath the island banners. Each delegation adds its name.
Ren places the charter beside the captain’s chair. The hearing records the crew’s chosen leader.

campaign.title: The voyage you name
campaign.place: the launch deck of a newly commissioned expedition ship
campaign.incident: The new crew is ready to choose its first destination. The charter requires a final independent mathematical record before the ceremony. Your investigations complete that record; the ship’s engineering and physical safety are outside these exercises.
campaign.role: You complete the expedition record and then choose how the crew will name its next voyage.
campaign.cast: Nara carries the old banner onto the launch deck. Kei brings the diary, Sora the island letters, and Ren the signed charter. The crew leaves a space beside the ship’s nameplate for your decision.
choice: Name the voyage after the islands it connects
Name it after a promise the crew chooses together
campaign.closure: The completed record is sealed. The crew adopts your chosen account, the launch ceremony begins, and this episode ends.
choiceOutcomes: The crew paints the island names beside the voyage’s title. Sora adds the smallest island last, where everyone can see it.
The crew gathers around the nameplate and agrees on a promise. Kei records it on the diary’s first new page.
